indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Recovered a little of Thursday's slide but still lost 2.7% on the week.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Led the rebound as chip stocks bounced, ending the week down 3.4%.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Slipped about 237 points and finished the week down 0.9%.

notes: Tech steadied after Thursday's AI sell-off: the semiconductor index rose about 4%, though it remains far below where it began the week.
October payrolls rose 165,000, well above forecasts, and unemployment dipped to 4.1%; the strong data added to talk of a possible Fed rate hike in December.
The VIX eased about 9% to near 25.6, the 10-year Treasury yield edged up to about 4.86%, and WTI crude held near $90.
